## English

- Desktop Remote Web and Android now group multiple reasoning and plan segments from the same assistant turn into one default-collapsed analysis section.
- The assistant answer remains visible on both clients; tapping the analysis section expands the complete reasoning, while tool activity rows remain in place.
- Publishes the Android app as version `0.4.25` with Android `versionCode 36`.

## 中文

- Desktop Remote Web 和 Android 端现在都会把同一条助手回复中的多段 reasoning/plan 合并为一个默认收起的分析区。
- 两端正文都保持可见，点击分析区即可展开全部推理；工具活动行继续保留在原位置。
- 发布版本 `0.4.25` 的 Android App（Android `versionCode 36`）。
